stableSettings.loadFailed.zh-CN: 设置暂时无法读取，请重试。
stableSettings.loadFailed.en-US: Settings are temporarily unavailable. Try again.

stableSettings.desc.metadataBuild.zh-CN: 提取文件属性，用于更多筛选条件。
stableSettings.desc.metadataBuild.en-US: Extract file attributes for additional filter conditions.

stableSettings.metadataBuildOpenFailed.zh-CN: 未能打开建库管理，请重试。
stableSettings.metadataBuildOpenFailed.en-US: Could not open extraction management. Please try again.

stableSettings.desc.language.zh-CN: 选择界面语言；“跟随系统”将使用当前 Windows 显示语言。
stableSettings.desc.language.en-US: Choose the interface language. The system option uses the current Windows display language.

stableSettings.desc.launch.zh-CN: 登录 Windows 后自动启动 Cap7CE。
stableSettings.desc.launch.en-US: Start Cap7CE after you sign in to Windows.

stableSettings.desc.notifications.zh-CN: 显示首次后台运行提示，以及自动缓存优化完成通知。
stableSettings.desc.notifications.en-US: Show the initial background-running notice and notifications when background cache optimization finishes.

stableSettings.desc.edgeCollapse.zh-CN: 标准窗口模式保留窗口最大化与窗口贴靠功能；边缘收起模式会在窗口贴在屏幕边缘时自动隐藏。
stableSettings.desc.edgeCollapse.en-US: Standard Window mode keeps window maximize and Windows Snap available. Edge Auto-hide mode hides a window automatically when it is placed at a screen edge.

stableSettings.desc.material.zh-CN: 选择主窗口、设置与预览窗口使用的亚克力或云母效果；不可用时自动使用纯色背景。
stableSettings.desc.material.en-US: Choose Acrylic or Mica for the main, Settings, and preview windows. If unavailable, a solid background is used.

stableSettings.desc.uiFontSize.zh-CN: 调整主窗口、设置页、预览信息和弹出菜单的字体大小。
stableSettings.desc.uiFontSize.en-US: Adjust text size in the main window, Settings, preview information, and pop-up menus.

stableSettings.desc.theme.zh-CN: 跟随 Windows 主题，或始终使用明亮、黑暗模式。
stableSettings.desc.theme.en-US: Follow the Windows theme, or always use Light or Dark mode.

stableSettings.desc.colors.zh-CN: 调整图标及按钮等内容的风格化颜色。
stableSettings.desc.colors.en-US: Adjust the stylized colors used by icons, buttons, and other interface elements.

stableSettings.desc.folders.zh-CN: 添加、重命名或移除参与正式搜索的目录，并查看支持文件数量。
stableSettings.desc.folders.en-US: Add, rename, or remove folders used by formal search and review their supported file counts.

stableSettings.desc.runtime.zh-CN: 选择本机 llama.cpp 版本，并手动启动或停止本地推理服务。
stableSettings.desc.runtime.en-US: Select a local llama.cpp version and manually start or stop the inference service.

stableSettings.desc.model.zh-CN: 选择自动添加关键词使用的本地视觉模型。
stableSettings.desc.model.en-US: Choose the local vision model used to generate keywords.

stableSettings.desc.cacheOptimization.zh-CN: 在后台逐步生成搜索缩略图；使用 Cap7CE 时自动降低处理频率。
stableSettings.desc.cacheOptimization.en-US: Generate search thumbnails gradually in the background and automatically slow down while Cap7CE is in use.

stableSettings.desc.formalCache.zh-CN: 缓存缩略图与预览内容，清理后按需重新生成。
stableSettings.desc.formalCache.en-US: Caches thumbnails and previews. Rebuilt on demand after clearing.

stableSettings.desc.skimCache.zh-CN: 查看并清理 Skim 浏览产生的缩略图、预览和元数据缓存。
stableSettings.desc.skimCache.en-US: View and clear the thumbnail, preview, and metadata cache created by Skim browsing.

stableSettings.optimizationSummary.zh-CN: 队列 {queued} · 已处理 {processed} · 失败 {failed}

stableSettings.optimizationNoWork.zh-CN: 检查完成 · 无需优化

stableSettings.optimizationCompleted.zh-CN: 检查完成 · 已处理 {processed} · 失败 {failed}

stableSettings.desc.quickActions.zh-CN: 启用并设置主窗口、窗口模式、line、目录切换和设置页的快捷键。
stableSettings.desc.quickActions.en-US: Enable and configure shortcuts for the main window, window mode, line, folder cycling, and Settings.

stableSettings.desc.quickCommands.zh-CN: 在搜索框或路径编辑框中输入指令，回车执行。
stableSettings.desc.quickCommands.en-US: Enter commands in the search or path field, then press Enter.

stableSettings.desc.diagnostics.zh-CN: 查看日志和崩溃报告位置，开启详细记录，或导出脱敏诊断包。
stableSettings.desc.diagnostics.en-US: View log and crash-report locations, enable detailed logging, or export a sanitized diagnostics bundle.

stableSettings.desc.runtimeInfo.zh-CN: 查看本地推理服务、llama.cpp 运行目录和模型文件的当前状态。
stableSettings.desc.runtimeInfo.en-US: View the current status of the local inference service, llama.cpp runtime folder, and model files.

stableSettings.desc.update.zh-CN: 手动检查并下载更新；Cap7CE 不会在后台自动更新。
stableSettings.desc.update.en-US: Check for and download updates manually. Cap7CE does not update automatically in the background.

stableSettings.desc.license.zh-CN: Cap7CE 自有源码使用 PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0；第三方组件适用各自许可证。
stableSettings.desc.license.en-US: Cap7CE source uses PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0; third-party components retain their own licenses.

stableSettings.directoryCount.zh-CN: {directories} 个目录 · {files} 个支持文件

stableSettings.directoryCountUnknown.zh-CN: {directories} 个目录 · 文件数量读取中

stableSettings.directoryEmpty.en-US: No search folders have been added.

stableSettings.directoryConflict.zh-CN: 所选目录与现有配置重叠。是否以新目录替换冲突项？
stableSettings.directoryConflict.en-US: The selected folder overlaps existing entries. Replace the conflicting entries with the new folder?

stableSettings.confirmDeleteDirectory.zh-CN: 确定移除“{name}”吗？源文件不会被删除。
stableSettings.confirmDeleteDirectory.en-US: Remove “{name}”? Source files will not be deleted.

stableSettings.confirmClearCache.zh-CN: 清理缩略图与预览缓存？下次浏览时会按需重新生成；不会删除源文件、索引、关键词或模型。
stableSettings.confirmClearCache.en-US: Clear thumbnail and preview caches? They will be rebuilt on demand. Source files, indexes, keywords and models are preserved.

stableSettings.confirmClearSkimCache.zh-CN: 确定清理独立 Skim 缓存吗？源文件不会受到影响。
stableSettings.confirmClearSkimCache.en-US: Clear the separate Skim cache? Source files will not be affected.

settings.cacheOptimizationRunning.zh-CN: {count}个 / {size}　正在自动优化：已处理 {processed}，剩余 {remaining}。

settings.cacheOptimizationDisabled.zh-CN: {count}个 / {size}　自动优化已关闭，开启可提升浏览体验。
settings.cacheOptimizationDisabled.en-US: {count} items / {size}  Automatic optimization is off. Turn it on for smoother browsing.

settings.shortcutUnavailable.zh-CN: 当前设置不可用，需重新设置
settings.shortcutUnavailable.en-US: This shortcut is unavailable. Choose another.

settings.confirmationCommandHint.zh-CN: 执行前将在输入框内要求输入 y / n 二次确认。
settings.confirmationCommandHint.en-US: Enter y or n in the input field to confirm before execution.

settings.confirmInstallUpdate.en-US: Cap7CE will start the installer and exit safely. Continue?

settings.updateInstalling.en-US: Starting the installer and exiting Cap7CE

settings.updateUnsupported.en-US: The installer cannot be started in development mode. Test with an installed build.

settings.disableSystemNotificationsHint.en-US: Click to turn off system notifications

settings.cancelShortcutCaptureHint.en-US: Press Esc or click elsewhere to cancel

settings.exportDiagnosticsHint.zh-CN: 点击导出诊断数据（文字日志会脱敏）
settings.exportDiagnosticsHint.en-US: Click to export diagnostics (text logs are sanitized)

shortcut.focusMainSearch.zh-CN: 显示主窗口并聚焦搜索
shortcut.focusMainSearch.en-US: Show main window and focus search

shortcut.restoreDefaultWindow.zh-CN: 默认大小和位置打开主窗口
shortcut.restoreDefaultWindow.en-US: Open main window at default size and position

language.description.zh-CN: 选择界面及 AI 生成关键词使用的语言，立即生效。
language.description.en-US: Choose the language for the interface and AI-generated keywords. Changes take effect immediately.

native.metadata.description.zh-CN: 读取文件属性，用于尺寸、颜色等筛选。勾选下方目录可跳过提取。
native.metadata.description.en-US: Read file properties for filters such as dimensions and colors. Select directories below to exclude them.

native.maintenance.description.zh-CN: 后台连接或索引服务异常时，可重新连接或修复。
native.maintenance.description.en-US: Reconnect or repair the service if the background connection or indexing service fails.

native.material.description.zh-CN: 选择主窗口、设置与预览窗口使用的云母或云母 Alt 效果；不可用时自动使用纯色背景。
native.material.description.en-US: Choose Mica or Mica Alt for the main, settings and preview windows. A solid background is used when unavailable.

native.cache.description.zh-CN: 缓存缩略图与预览内容，清理后按需重新生成；源文件、索引和关键词保持不变。
native.cache.description.en-US: Cache thumbnails and preview content. Cleared content is regenerated as needed; source files, indexes and keywords are preserved.

native.diagnostics.logs.en-US: Native startup and Core error logs

native.diagnostics.recordPresent.en-US: Startup or error records are available

native.diagnostics.exportDescription.zh-CN: 导出原生运行信息及已记录的错误，不包含素材、数据库或偏好文件。
native.diagnostics.exportDescription.en-US: Export native runtime information and recorded errors. Assets, databases and preference files are excluded.

native.update.description.zh-CN: 仅在主动点击时检查正式WinUI更新，不下载或安装Electron发布。
native.update.description.en-US: Check for official WinUI updates only when requested. Electron releases are not downloaded or installed.

native.shortcut.unavailable.zh-CN: 此窗口动作尚未迁入WinUI，不注册其快捷键。
native.shortcut.unavailable.en-US: This window action is not available in WinUI. Its shortcut is not registered.

help.command.dir_rename.en-US: Rename the favorite without renaming its folder

native.colors.invalid.en-US: Enter a six-digit hexadecimal color, such as #FFC9ED.

native.index.description.zh-CN: 建立文件名与目录索引，用于快速搜索。
native.index.description.en-US: Build an index of file names and directories for fast searching.

main.compactView.en-US: A horizontal grid is used in short windows. Increase the height to restore the selected view.

menu.renameUnavailable.en-US: Renaming folders is not yet available in WinUI.

menu.editKeywordsUnavailable.en-US: Select files and open the details pane on the right.

main.adjustFilters.en-US: Try changing the search terms or filters.

main.emptyFolder.zh-CN: 此文件夹中没有可显示的内容。
main.emptyFolder.en-US: There are no items to display in this folder.

main.sliderHelp.en-US: Default: {value}. Use arrow keys for small adjustments and Page Up or Page Down for larger adjustments.
